source: reconstruction of a private repository with every action pinned
note: A private repository's workflows cannot be published in this corpus, so this is a minimal reproduction of the shape: every action pinned by SHA from GitHub's own owners, checkout credentials not persisted, main protected, a tag-triggered release in an environment. The one entry is the pull request title echoed into the step summary of a test job holding a read token: Medium on a public repository, and one tier down to Low here, since visibility is proven private and a contributor entry then needs an account with access (spec ruling 3).
